about.title: A Home For The Adventurous, Anchored On The Red Sea
about.text: Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina is an urban and recreational oasis on the picturesque Red Sea, situated near Jeddah’s City Center, the Red Sea Mall, and the F1 racetrack.
